name: Pending Payment Cart Ready Race Fix
symptom: Tambah Semula could show Sistem troli belum tersedia because purchase UI became interactive before storefront async init exposed the cart API.
rootCause: azobss-pabm-storefront init awaited user price adjustment before assigning window.azobssPaBmStoreCart.
fixes: publish cart API before price-adjustment await
wait/poll up to 15 seconds from global-auth
dynamic import storefront v1248 as startup fallback
